en.name: House number sign
en.desc: Layered 3D house number sign with floating numbers on hidden spacers, 10 board shapes, 6 fonts, 4 layouts, dual text lines, motifs, dividers, frames and 8 mounting options.
en.keys: house number address sign plaque door street 3d layered spacer shadow mounting nameplate
en.label: House sign {num} ({w} × {h} mm)
en.number.title: Supports digits 0–9, letters A–Z (lowercase renders as small-caps like 12a), umlauts Ä Ö Ü, and - / . + &.
en.boldness.title: Adjusts glyph stroke thickness from slim (70%) to extra bold (140%).
en.street.title: Optional street name or address line. Leave empty to omit.
en.subtitle: Subtitle / second line
en.subtitle.title: Optional second line such as family name, postal code, city or year.
en.spacerLayers.title: Number of stacked hidden spacer layers under each character to create shadow depth.
en.spacerInset.title: How much smaller each hidden spacer is than the front number so it stays invisible and casts a shadow.
en.pinHoles.title: Cuts alignment dowel/toothpick holes through board and spacers for effortless gluing.
en.backplate.title: Adds a second backing layer for extra rigidity or concealed keyhole mounting.
en.partLabels.title: Engraves tiny hidden part numbers on each spacer layer to simplify assembly.
en.fromMaterial.title: Reads sheet thickness and calibrated kerf from the selected KizamuBeam material.
en.thickness.title: Sheet thickness used for 3D preview and total standoff depth.
en.kerf.title: Compensates cut parts outward by half the kerf width.
en.separatePages.title: Places board on page 1, contrast front numbers/frame on page 2, and hidden spacers on page 3.
en.material-none: No material with thickness is assigned to the active layer.
en.material-no-kerf: The active material has no calibrated kerf; using {kerf} mm.
en.number-empty: Enter at least one supported character for the house number.
en.number-too-long: House number can contain at most {max} characters.
en.number-unsupported: Skipped unsupported characters in house number: {chars}
en.board-too-small: The board dimensions are too small.
en.content-overflow: The numbers extend beyond the custom board size; enlarge board or reduce number height.
en.frame-too-wide: The raised frame width is too large for this board.
en.spacer-inset-large: Spacer inset is very large for this stroke width (recommended at most {max} mm).
en.cutout-small: Cut-out numbers under 25 mm high may have fragile stencil bridges.
en.bridge-wide: Bridge width is large relative to the number height.
en.keyhole-shaft-wide: Keyhole slot width must be narrower than the screw head diameter.
en.raised-text-small: Raised street letters under 12 mm high are very small to cut and glue.
en.exceeds-work-area: Board ({w} × {h} mm) exceeds machine work area ({aw} × {ah} mm).
